name: Transactional email, SMS and delivery outbox

operations.retention: Encrypted message payloads remain only as long as queue operations require; define sent/dead row retention and secure deletion before production.
operations.recovery: Restore PostgreSQL outbox and the matching AES-256-GCM key; reclaim expired worker leases and inspect dead letters before requeue.
operations.enableDisable: Disable delivery only via an operations change; retain durable enqueue or fail authentication email callbacks rather than dropping messages.
